In Rookgaard you can earn both addons of the Citizen outfit, the same ones you earn on the mainland. {npc:Norma} teaches you to make the feathered hat in exchange for chicken feathers, honeycombs and a helmet, and {npc:Amber} makes you the backpack from 100 minotaur leathers.
The same addons that are earned on the mainland.
Norma, north of the Rookgaard Academy
No minimum level (level 6+ recommended for the minotaurs).
The Citizen outfit is already available to all players: this quest only gives the addons.
hat; trade a present with Seymour
Gather all the items before you talk to the NPCs.

{item:Chicken Feather|Chicken Feathers} drop from {creature:Chicken|Chickens}, {item:Honeycomb|Honeycombs} from {creature:Wasp|Wasps} and/or {creature:Bear|Bears}, and {item:Minotaur Leather} from {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs}.
Hand the leather to Amber first: she takes 2 hours to make the backpack and you can take care of the hat in the meantime.
Go to the Rookgaard Academy and trade a {item:Present|present} for the {item:Legion Helmet} with {npc:Seymour}.
Gather the feathers and the honeycombs
Kill {creature:Chicken|chickens} until you have 100 {item:Chicken Feather|Chicken Feathers} and {creature:Wasp|wasps} and/or {creature:Bear|bears} until you have 50 {item:Honeycomb|Honeycombs}.
Go to {npc:Norma}'s shop, just **north** of the Academy. Say {key:hi}, {key:hat} and {key:yes}.
With everything in your inventory, go back to Norma and say {key:hi}, {key:hat} and {key:yes}. She makes you the hat.
Go down to the Resting Room under the Academy and talk to {npc:Amber}. Say {key:hi}, {key:addon}, {key:minotaur leather} and {key:yes}.
Amber, Resting Room under the Academy
With the leather in your inventory, say {key:hi}, {key:backpack} and {key:yes}.
Wait **2 hours**, go back to Amber and say {key:hi} and {key:addon}. She gives you the backpack.
